name: ulara-ds
$doc: R326 M0.4 — the ONE source of truth for the shared ds design tokens (web + mobile). Provenance: frontend/src/styles/tokens/tokens.css (R313/R322/R323/R324 canon) and the r325-era apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.ts hand-copy it replaces. Regen: npm run tokens:build (repo root). Outputs: frontend/src/styles/tokens/tokens.generated.css (web CSS vars, imported BEFORE tokens.css, same @layer tokens) + apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts (mobile TS). Drift gate: npm run tokens:check (CI-enforced). Reference grammar: 'neutral.50' | 'triad.<family>.<bg|ink|deep>' | 'brand.<key>' | a semantic seat name (another ref, one tier up) | a literal '#hex'. External seat: brand.warmInk emits var(--warm-ink) on web — its definition stays hand-written in tokens.css base :root. NOT shared (deliberately): the web fluid-rem type ladder + font stacks (tokens.css hand section — web-only), the mobile px ladder lives here under typography.mobile; --state-focus-ring-color / --danger-fg / glass / veils / chrome / charts stay hand-written in tokens.css (web-only seats).

brand.$doc: The ULARA brand colours — the OWNER-APPROVED palette (2026-11-21, the final brand decision): paper #F5F1E8 · ink #1A1713 · PRIMARY #2540D9 (dark #8AA0FF) — the action colour — plus the warm DECORATIVE accent #F15534 (never an action or a danger tone), the night ink #262019 and the dark ground #262019. Contrast (recomputed, WCAG 2.1): primary on paper 6.62:1 · white on primary 7.46:1 · white on hover 10.02:1 · dark primary on dark ground 6.56:1 · dark ink on dark primary 6.56:1 · white on dark hover 4.83:1. Consumed by the RN <Logo> tones and the mobile palette; web emits var(--warm-ink) refs only.

neutral.$doc: The warm vintage-paper ramp (R313). Light: near-white ground #F6F6EE over white surfaces, charcoal ink #282828 (13.57:1 AAA). Dark: the charcoal itself as ground (#282828), surfaces one step up (#2E2E2E), warm hairlines #4A4A48/#5C5C5A, near-white ink. neutral-900 dark is the R324 X22 warm paper twin #F6F6EE (was #F6F8FA — that spelling is on the parity gate's FORBIDDEN list). R351-final: the light ink re-keys to the approved #1A1713.

triad.$doc: The 9 section families (R351-final re-key: mint = the approved success #17724A/#5FD39A, rose = the approved danger #C62828/#FF7A70; each a soft tinted ground (band fill), a saturated ink for fills/UI accents, a deep shade for text — success/danger are AA as their own text ink, so deep = ink).  pins (yellow/grey/peach deep-vs-bg ≥4.5 both themes) and icon-well pins (light -deep on -bg ≥3:1) verified: mint 7.31 · yellow 7.85 · rose 7.22 · sky 7.74 · peach 6.29 · grey 12.55 · sand 7.62 · lavender 9.24 · copper 6.10. Dark = deep ember-tinted grounds + luminous inks (family ink-on-bg ≥6.5; the ember ink 4.73 AA-large/UI by design).

copper.$doc: The signal family — the ONE burnt sienna #C43E16 (the brand accent seat). AA on paper at 4.60:1 (normal text); hover/text routing through accentInk #A33312 (6.13:1). Dark ink is the luminous ember #FF6B3D (5.70:1 on the dark ground, AA).

semantic.$doc: The role seats components consume — the OWNER-APPROVED palette (2026-11-21). Two-surface rule: bg = PAGE GROUND (paper), surface = CARD GROUND — hierarchy via surface step + hairlines, zero shadows (R313). PRIMARY is the action colour: #2540D9 light (white labels 7.46:1) / #8AA0FF dark (ink labels 6.56:1), hover #1B30B0 / #4C63F0, subtle #E4E9FF / #2A2F4A (the dark primary reads 5.33:1 on it, its text tier #A9B8FF 6.85:1). SUCCESS #17724A light (5.26:1 on paper) / #5FD39A dark (8.65:1). DANGER #C62828 light (4.99:1) / #FF7A70 dark (6.35:1). The WARM accent #F15534 (brand.warmAccent) is DECORATIVE only — 3.06:1 on paper, so it never carries body text, never stands in for the primary action and never for danger.

mobile.$doc: Mobile-only palette seats (no web var counterpart): the hover step and the sheet-overlay ground, expressed as refs so they track the ramps.

tones.$doc: The status-tone families (mobile statusTones / notification & attendance kinds), in display order.

webAliases.$doc: Web-only alias namespace (r305 — the warm secondary of the reference; resolves onto the peach seat). Emitted verbatim into both theme blocks.

spacing.$doc: The 4px-base ladder. `webRungs` carries the HISTORICAL web rung names (the r305 re-key kept the names and re-keyed the values — index ≠ px/4 above --sp-6: --sp-7 IS 32px, --sp-16 IS 240px); `px` is the px-keyed ladder the mobile app consumes. Every webRung value must exist in px with the same value (validated). The --sp-Nx legacy aliases stay hand-written in tokens.css.

radius.$doc: R313: the ladder collapses to 0 — square corners everywhere; ONLY genuinely circular primitives (avatars, status dots) consume full.

motion.$doc: The measured ds register (r305 census: .4s ×174 dominant; decel standard .23,1,.32,1). Web: the prefers-reduced-motion kill in tokens.css zeroes the rungs by import order. The --ease-out/in/linear/soft/spring family stays hand-written in tokens.css (web-only).

typography.$doc: The mobile px ladder (Arabic 13px readability floor; hierarchy via weight + size, no tracking). The WEB type voice is the fluid-rem ladder + font stacks hand-written in tokens.css (R313) — platform-specific by design, not shared here.
